moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: 110
Accuracy: 70
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.

moves.name: Freeze-Dry
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. This move's type effectiveness against Water is changed to be super effective no matter what this move's type is.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.

moves.name: Aurora Veil
moves.description:
Ice (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: 55
Accuracy: 95
Priority: 0
Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

moves.name: Moonblast
moves.description:
Fairy (Special)
Base Power: 95
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Disable
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Max or G-Max Move.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description:
Fairy (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
No additional effect.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 5
The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Light Clay
items.description: Holder's use of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, or Reflect lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Occa Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fire-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Icy Rock
items.description: Holder's use of Snowscape lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

items.name: Babiri Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Steel-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

abilities.name: Snow Warning
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.

abilities.name: Snow Cloak
abilities.description: If Snow is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8.
